Indie rock darlings the Grand Duchy, the five-member Dawes recently relocated to Northern California, and they're ready to put in all those hours in their new 1,600-square-foot venue.

Dawes, however, aren't just your typical old-school rock band with a bit of modern cred: the band's roots rock with a hint of pop production is part of their charm. Goldsworthy is good at writing pop songs, as he proved during his time with the very pop Grand Duchy, but the best things here are his raw vocals on songs that are either soaring and angelic, or scratchy and heartbreaking.
